'''Rago''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|III|74|Rago Run}}</ref> located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] that anchored the [[Rago Run]] to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was the closest [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] planet to [[the Colony]] of the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]].
